name: Victus Engine
author: admin@victuscloud.com
description: Victus Engine 26.2 with optional ViaVersion/ViaBackwards support for older Java clients and Geyser/Floodgate support for Bedrock/mobile clients. Requires Java 25.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
cd /mnt/server
JAR_NAME="${SERVER_JARFILE:-victus.jar}"
DOWNLOAD_URL="${VICTUS_DOWNLOAD_URL:-https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gravatar123A/victus-engine-builds/363247b38404d37474ec02008209a898346c511c/victus-server.jar}"
TEMP_JAR="${JAR_NAME}.download"
echo "Downloading Victus Engine from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
rm -f "${TEMP_JAR}"
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --output "${TEMP_JAR}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
test -s "${TEMP_JAR}"
EXPECTED_SHA256="${VICTUS_SHA256:-db285d9d66e7ac76976c6ee2be2462982b916c9a9342a1367551c0c0bae0cf7e}"
printf '%s  %s\n' "${EXPECTED_SHA256}" "${TEMP_JAR}" | sha256sum -c -
unzip -t "${TEMP_JAR}" >/dev/null
if [ -f "${JAR_NAME}" ]; then cp -f "${JAR_NAME}" "${JAR_NAME}.previous"; fi
mv -f "${TEMP_JAR}" "${JAR_NAME}"
mkdir -p plugins
if [ "${INSTALL_PROTOCOL_SUPPORT:-1}" = "1" ]; then
  for PROJECT in ViaVersion ViaBackwards; do
    echo "Resolving latest ${PROJECT} Paper build"
    PLUGIN_URL=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error "https://hangar.papermc.io/api/v1/projects/${PROJECT}/versions?limit=1&offset=0" | jq -r '.result[0].downloads.PAPER.downloadUrl // empty')
    test -n "${PLUGIN_URL}"
    curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --output "plugins/${PROJECT}.jar.download" "${PLUGIN_URL}"
    unzip -t "plugins/${PROJECT}.jar.download" >/dev/null
    mv -f "plugins/${PROJECT}.jar.download" "plugins/${PROJECT}.jar"
  done
fi
if [ "${INSTALL_BEDROCK_SUPPORT:-1}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "Installing current Geyser and Floodgate Spigot builds"
  curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --output plugins/Geyser-Spigot.jar.download "https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/geyser/versions/latest/builds/latest/downloads/spigot"
  curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --output plugins/floodgate-spigot.jar.download "https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/floodgate/versions/latest/builds/latest/downloads/spigot"
  unzip -t plugins/Geyser-Spigot.jar.download >/dev/null
  unzip -t plugins/floodgate-spigot.jar.download >/dev/null
  mv -f plugins/Geyser-Spigot.jar.download plugins/Geyser-Spigot.jar
  mv -f plugins/floodgate-spigot.jar.download plugins/floodgate-spigot.jar
  mkdir -p plugins/Geyser-Spigot
  cat > plugins/Geyser-Spigot/config.yml <<'GEYSER_CONFIG'
bedrock:
  address: 0.0.0.0
  port: 19132
  clone-remote-port: true
java:
  auth-type: floodgate
GEYSER_CONFIG
fi
printf 'eula=%s\n' "${EULA:-false}" > eula.txt
echo "Victus Engine installation complete."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Victus Engine is built on Minecraft/Paper 26.2. Older supported clients connect through ViaVersion rather than by replacing the engine core.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The JAR filename used to start Victus Engine.

variables.name: Victus Download URL
variables.description: Immutable URL for the validated Victus Engine build from source commit 02ae25c.

variables.name: Victus JAR SHA-256
variables.description: Expected SHA-256 for the selected Victus JAR. Installation aborts on mismatch.

variables.name: Install Java Protocol Support
variables.description: Install current ViaVersion and ViaBackwards so supported older Java clients can connect. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Install Bedrock / Mobile Support
variables.description: Install current Geyser and Floodgate builds. Geyser shares the server allocation port over UDP for phone and Bedrock clients.

variables.name: Accept Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Set to true to accept https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA
